mia.title: Pay instantly by phone number

consent.title: Your data, kept safe
consent.lead: Before we start, please read how we use your data and give your consent.

summary.profile: Other users see your profile and photos, so you can get to know each other.
summary.location: Your city and approximate coordinates are used only to calculate distance; your exact address is never shown.
summary.chat: Messages, likes and matches are stored so the app can work; contact details in chats are masked automatically.
summary.events: For events and tickets we process your order details and proof of payment.
summary.rights: You can download your data, withdraw optional consents or delete your account at any time, right in the app.

consent.checkTerms: I am at least 18 years old and accept the Terms of Use
consent.checkPrivacy: I agree to the processing of my personal data in accordance with the Privacy Policy
consent.checkSensitive: I agree to the processing of my selfie for profile verification (biometric data). I can withdraw this consent at any time.
consent.error: We couldn't save your consent. Please try again.
consent.stale: The documents have just been updated. Please confirm them again.
consent.footnote: The app is for adults 18+ only. Without your consent we cannot create and run your account.

sensitive.title: Consent for selfie verification
sensitive.body: Verification compares a selfie with your profile photos. A selfie is biometric data, so we need your explicit consent.
sensitive.pointWhat: The selfie is used only to confirm that the photos are yours.
sensitive.pointStorage: The selfie is not stored: we keep only the result (verified or not).
sensitive.pointWithdraw: You can withdraw consent at any time under “Privacy & data”. Without it, only the verified badge is missing.
sensitive.check: I explicitly consent to the processing of my selfie for verification
